AddIpamMembers.description_en: Adds members to an IP Address Manager (IPAM)
AddIpamMembers.description_zh: 添加IPAM可信服务纳管成员

AddIpamPoolCidr.description_en: Provisions a CIDR block for an IPAM pool

AssociateIpamResourceDiscovery.description_en: Associates a resource discovery with an IPAM instance

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Changes the resource group of an IPAM resource
ChangeResourceGroup.description_zh: 修改IPAM资源所属的资源组

CreateIpamPoolAllocation.description_en: Creates a custom reserved CIDR block from an IPAM pool
CreateIpamPoolAllocation.description_zh: 从IPAM地址池创建自定义预留网段

CreateIpamResourceDiscovery.description_zh: 创建自定义类型的资源发现实例

CreateIpamScope.description_en: Creates scopes for IPAM to manage private and public IP addresses
CreateIpamScope.description_zh: 创建私网和公网IPAM作用范围，分别用于管理私网和公网地址

DeleteIpamPoolAllocation.description_en: Releases a CIDR allocation from an IP Address Management (IPAM) address pool. Supported allocation types include virtual private cloud (VPC) and custom allocation
DeleteIpamPoolAllocation.description_zh: 释放IPAM地址池的CIDR分配，当前支持的类型包括专有网络、自定义分配

DissociateIpamResourceDiscovery.description_en: Disassociates a resource discovery from an IP Address Manager (IPAM) instance
DissociateIpamResourceDiscovery.description_zh: 解关联资源发现和IPAM实例

GetIpamPoolAllocation.description_en: Queries a specified CIDR block allocation in an IPAM pool
GetIpamPoolAllocation.description_zh: 查询指定IPAM地址池CIDR分配的信息

GetIpamPoolNextAvailableCidr.description_en: Retrieves an available CIDR block from an IPAM pool
GetIpamPoolNextAvailableCidr.description_zh: 获取IPAM地址池可用的CIDR地址段

GetVpcIpamServiceStatus.description_en: Retrieves the status of the IPAM service

ListIpamDiscoveredIpAddresses.description_en: Lists the IP addresses used by discovered resources in a VPC or vSwitch
ListIpamDiscoveredIpAddresses.description_zh: 查询已发现资源中VPC或VSwitch下已使用IP信息

ListIpamDiscoveredResource.description_en: Queries resource information under a resource discovery
ListIpamDiscoveredResource.description_zh: 查询资源发现下的资源信息

ListIpamMembers.description_en: Lists the members managed by the IPAM trusted service
ListIpamMembers.description_zh: 查询IPAM可信服务纳管成员

ListIpamPoolAllocations.description_en: Queries CIDR block allocations in an IPAM pool

ListIpamPoolCidrs.description_zh: 查询IPAM地址池预置的CIDR地址段

ListIpamResourceCidrs.description_zh: 查询IPAM作用范围内的资源

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are associated with resources

OpenVpcIpamService.description_en: Activates the IP Address Management (IPAM) service

RemoveIpamMembers.description_en: Removes members from the IPAM trusted service
RemoveIpamMembers.description_zh: 移除IPAM可信服务纳管成员

TagResources.description_en: Adds a tag to a resource
TagResources.description_zh: 为资源实例绑定资源标签

UntagResources.description_en: Removes a tag from a resource

UpdateIpam.description_en: Modifies an IP Address Management (IPAM) instance

UpdateIpamPool.description_en: Updates the basic information of an IPAM pool

UpdateIpamPoolAllocation.description_en: Updates a CIDR allocation from an IPAM address pool
